findings: H100 完成 12 轮微调，选中第 3 轮。训练加入 2,674 个屋面、611 个贴屋面的高树冠和 4,855 个地面回波，并回放 Richmond 训练样本。
在独立 DC 点级测试的贴树区域，同为 90% 屋面点召回时，保留高树冠的比例由 12.49% 降至 11.51%。模拟只保留 20% 邻域回波时，由 27.99% 降至 22.84%。
从 61 栋新建筑冻结的参照中，49 栋可评分。四组方法依表格顺序，在 695 个贴树屋面点上命中 434、449、458、383 个，在 202 个冠顶点上误命中 0、0、0、1 个。高度容差为 0.35 米。
比较两组校准方案，微调后全部屋面、贴树屋面的按栋平均命中率分别变化 -1.83、-6.61 个百分点。留出集的屋面命中率差距超过预设的 2 个百分点。
Boston 222 两个平台的 17 个原始支持点，四组几何命中数依次为 17、17、17、17。
冠顶几何参照仅来自 8 栋建筑。训练标签使用供方分类和几何筛选，部分回波具备跨航测支持。参照适用于局部屋面高度，完整实体闭合仍待核验。

geometry.scope: Model-blind retrospective stability selection. Restricts conclusions to the matched roof interiors and canopy observations, and cannot validate missing or changed roof structures.
geometry.canopy_definition: Independent 2022 class 5 with coincident historical returns at least 0.75 m above two nearby stable roof points. Proximity to canopy observations cannot establish full canopy surface validity.
geometry.interpretation: Each building is equally weighted within a stratum. A roof hit is desirable; a canopy-height hit is an observed false-roof proxy. No XY coverage is a miss. Intervals resample paired buildings within the same fixed three DC test blocks.

point_level_comparison.scope: NOAA 2022 provider building, vegetation and ground labels in reserved DC neighborhoods. Building class is a roof proxy. The roof-edge scope applies identical footprint/adjacency rule to both models. Crop and deterministic return thinning share identical LAS IDs.
point_level_comparison.operating_point_note: Benchmark thresholds at equal roof recall summarize ranking on held-out labels. They are not selected deployment thresholds or evidence of improved LoD2 surface geometry.

boston_222_point_regression.scope: Previously inspected field case; these are point predictions and do not measure reconstructed geometry.

training.checkpoint_selection: Minimize canopy retention at 80%, 90%, 95% roof recall on three Anacostia development density views. Prefer epochs retaining source validation roof recall and mIoU within 0.02 of parent. No geometry calibration or test neighborhoods were used.
